result.topic_en: A list of bibliographic notes on mathematical and scientific memoirs: Euler-type observations on the integral $\int x^{p-1}dx(1-x)^{(q-n)/n}$ from 0 to 1, a Vlissingen society paper on magic squares, the Berlin Ephemerides 1783, the Mémoires de la Société Économique 1766, and a note on a manuscript count.

methods.what: Integral of the form $\int_0^1 x^{p-1}(1-x)^{(q-n)/n}dx$ (Beta-type integral), evaluated by setting $x=1$ after integration
